externalDesignReferences: LobeChat floating chat panel and reusable input pattern
Open WebUI / Dify / AnythingLLM full-height workspace chat pattern
LibreChat / Chatbot UI autosizing composer pattern
bindingDecisions: Task21b is a frontend visual/interaction refactor only; do not change AI backend, provider key ownership, conversation DTO contracts, or document save semantics.
The document copilot and standalone/full workspace AI chat must share one mature chat visual language instead of separate control-panel UIs.
Safety/context/provider metadata stays visible and auditable but must be visually subordinate to the conversation; use collapsible/context-chip patterns instead of dominant meta grids.
Do not add Tailwind, Framer Motion, or icon libraries just to copy ResearchClaw; reuse concepts in Jixia CSS/React unless a dependency is explicitly justified.
Preserve Task21a no-writeback: AI output remains advisory/copyable only and never mutates the editor automatically.
preparation.rootProblem: Task21a made document AI functional, but the UI feels like an operations console: hard borders, status pills, model bars, meta grids, and context cards dominate over the actual conversation in both the inspector side panel and full AI work surface.
preparation.firstImplementationPriority: Establish a shared mature chat surface: conversation-first transcript, rounded message bubbles/assistant prose, low-noise composer, subdued context chips/drawer, and consistent visual tokens reused by document copilot and standalone AI chat.

noSuccessWithout: Document copilot inspector reads as a chat-first side panel, not a metadata/control panel.
Standalone/full AI chat reads as a mature workspace chat with clear transcript, sidebar/history, and bottom composer hierarchy.
Shared chat primitives or shared CSS patterns reduce duplicate visual logic across DocumentCopilotPanel and AIChatDialog/ChatShell.
Provider/model/context/safety state remains discoverable and accessible but no longer dominates the first screen.
Message rendering supports user bubbles, assistant prose, markdown/code/tables/sources, streaming state, copy/retry actions, and error states without regressing functionality.
Composer supports autosizing text, send/stop, provider/model visibility, disabled reasons, keyboard submit, and compact side-panel behavior.
No backend/API/provider-key/document writeback contracts are changed.
Focused tests for existing AI chat and document copilot still pass; visual manual review records side-panel and full-page observations.
forbiddenCompletionClaims: Adding more pills or more status labels makes the chat clearer.
The visual refactor may hide provider/key safety state completely.
It is acceptable to add Tailwind/Framer/Lucide just to copy another project without a clear dependency decision.
Only document copilot was polished, therefore the full AI workspace is done, or vice versa.
AI output can be auto-applied to the document as part of this visual task.

manualReview.reviewer: Human manual review after local provider-backed conversation
manualReview.summary: Provider configuration and AI conversation worked locally, but the user judged the AI chat surfaces still visually immature/ugly enough to require a dedicated follow-up task.
manualReview.agentGateResult: Finish agent passed Task21b acceptance with Playwright/manual evidence
